The XP investigation applies only to profile 0x4012A. Raw CAN/OBD capability has not been established for this connection. Only this profile’s mapped settings are available.
Extra XP cluster settings: not implemented. Meter layout, ambient color and OEM navigation display still lack a verified XP transport mapping.
Manual XP packets: the app implements the documented FYT decoder-packet route. Dispatch does not confirm a CAN transmission or a change in the vehicle.
Raw CAN/OBD: unverified. The researched OBD serial route does not establish an XP command accepting CAN address and data. This audit performs no transmission test.
Protocol reference: SYU 2.23.0711.1001. These are source-code findings; compare the installed service above. Decoder version text alone does not establish physical compatibility.
